india_trends.title: Arini’s Hedge Fund Losses Grow to 32% as It Sells Some Positions
india_trends.summary: Losses at Arini Capital Management’s main hedge fund deepened in the final days of October, taking declines to 32% for the year, according to a letter to investors seen by Bloomberg.

india_trends.title: Gold Extends Drop on Stronger-Than-Expected US Employment Data
india_trends.summary: Gold fell after a hot US nonfarm payrolls print added fuel to speculations that the Federal Reserve will seek to raise interest rates to contain inflation.

india_trends.title: Quick Mart IPO Draws Strong Demand as Kenyan Listings Pick Up
india_trends.summary: Quick Mart Plc saw demand for shares in its initial public offering exceed the number available by almost 23% as Kenya’s second-biggest supermarket chain concluded the nation’s second IPO of the year.

india_trends.title: Walleye to Return $2 Billion to Clients in Stocks Trading Reset
india_trends.summary: Walleye Capital plans to return about $2 billion to clients following its decision to cut back on equities trading.

india_trends.title: Angan Guha returns to Wipro as President and CEO for US units: Who is he? Why he re-joined the company?
india_trends.summary: Angan Guha is the former Birlasoft CEO. In Wipro, Guha will report to Srini Pallia, Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director.

india_trends.title: Deepinder Goyal's Temple gets thumbs-up from Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal: ‘True potential’
india_trends.summary: Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal praised Temple, Deepinder Goyal’s wearable, for its lightweight design, sleep tracking and food monitoring, saying it could become a global product made in India. He said its app’s user experience needed improvement.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Amid Ramayana release, PVR INOX launches Sattvik menu: No onion, no garlic kuttu tacos, khichdi and more
india_trends.summary: PVR INOX Ltd is offering a curated all-vegetarian menu to celebrate Ramayana release. It is also offering a special collection of Rudraksha which moviegoers can take home.

india_trends.title: Samvat 2082: Commodities witness sharp volatility as crude surges
india_trends.summary: Brent crude surged 60.4% in Samvat 2082 amid the US-Iran conflict, while gold and silver fell in dollar terms after retreating from record highs, though rupee depreciation supported domestic returns.

india_trends.summary: India's primary market raised a record ₹2.23 trillion through 375 IPOs in Samvat 2082, with mainboard issues accounting for ₹2.12 trillion and SME offerings for the rest.

india_trends.title: Weakest Samvat in 15 years ends on a high for mkts as Sensex, Nifty rally
india_trends.summary: The Sensex and Nifty ended Samvat 2082 with losses of 4% and 3.1%, respectively, despite a sharp late rally that delivered their biggest weekly gains in nearly six years.

india_trends.title: Dhanteras special: Gold beats stocks or Nifty takes the lead? Gold vs Nifty 50 returns in Samvat 2082 compared
india_trends.summary: Indian equities endured volatility in Samvat 2082 amid geopolitical tensions, oil-price swings and inflation concerns. A late rally lifted the Nifty 50 more than 10% in seven sessions, but the index is still set to finish the year down about 3.24%.
